title: ACE2-tropic betacoronavirus therapeutics (reconnab-multimers) for pandemic preparedness
core_idea: Design a new therapeutic format called reconnab-multimers that pairs a pan-betacoronavirus-binding antibody targeting a highly conserved spike epitope with an ACE2-based component (rendered catalytically inactive), leveraging avidity to achieve broad activity against betacoronaviruses that use ACE2 and to increase resilience to viral genetic evolution.
tldr: Introduce reconnab-multimers — a therapeutic strategy combining a conserved-epitope antibody and a catalytically inactive ACE2 component to enable broad, evolution-resilient countermeasures against ACE2-using betacoronaviruses for future pandemic preparedness.
